topics.label: Lecture framing: cancer hallmarks and their genetic basis
topics.groupedBecause: This opening establishes the lecture’s aims and its framework for connecting genetic mutations to cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Deregulated signaling promotes growth and survival
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how mutations in extracellular signaling pathways free cancer cells from normal controls on proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Differentiation blocks in blood cancers and intestinal epithelium
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how disrupted cellular differentiation contributes to cancer and becomes recognizable in tissue organization and cell identity.

topics.label: Resistance to apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how alterations in p53 signaling and the balance of mitochondrial apoptotic regulators allow cancer cells to evade death.

topics.label: Telomere maintenance and cancer cell immortalization
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the telomere-dependent limit on cell division and how increased telomerase expression enables cancer cells to bypass it.

topics.label: p53 stress responses and the growth-control recap
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics complete the account of growth-control safeguards by explaining p53-mediated responses to cellular stress before recapping the hallmarks discussed.

topics.label: Metabolic rewiring in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how altered metabolism characterizes cancer cells and can reinforce the molecular changes that sustain malignancy.

topics.label: The angiogenic switch in tumor growth
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how tumors recruit a blood supply to overcome limits on oxygen and nutrient delivery.

topics.label: Metastatic dissemination and successful colonization
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate what enables cancer cells to spread from a primary tumor and establish detectable tumors at distant sites.

topics.label: Closing synthesis and further reading
topics.groupedBecause: This closing draws together the convergence of diverse genetic routes on cancer hallmarks and ends with reading guidance and final remarks.
